name: cfcmt-bus-native-terminal-actor-unmasked-confirmation-v1

evaluation.test_separation: Predeclared before generating assets or submitting jobs;72581-72583/73581-73583 are disjoint from prior native collection/evaluation cohorts
evaluation.comparison: Twenty-one new evaluations: three frozen unmasked75000 actors and three frozen repaired55000 actors, each on three fresh generated demand cases, plus three actual rule runs
evaluation.completion: Report completion rate and departed/completed counts alongside cost.
evaluation.interpretation: Bounded pilot on one target city; no population-level CI or city removal.

asset_selection.ordering: Original route, direction, pattern and service id, before any control outcomes
asset_selection.network: GTFS-derived route corridors; APC-apportioned demand, generated destinations; not a measured city road network
asset_selection.calendar_rule: Earliest weekday in the pinned GTFS feed with active weekday service and without a holiday exception; keep the original 12-service subset
asset_selection.calendar_provenance: Actual trip_id/service_id and full stop signatures from GTFS; never merge mutually exclusive calendar services or clamp zero scheduled headways

checkpoint_rule: Freeze all three native_terminal_actor_unmasked/real_v_unmasked/seedN/policy.pt final75000 actors and all three native_terminal_adaptation/seedN/policy.pt final55000 actors; no further training or checkpoint/seed/gate selection
primary_comparison: Equal-weight full24000 passenger cost of unmasked75000 actors versus forward proportional gain0.6 rule and repaired55000 actors, all seeds and cases retained
diagnostic_trigger: Previously analyzed72571-72573 cases: unmasked75k mean cost2362.012701, rule2369.708118, adapted55k2363.774906; improvements are heterogeneous and largely driven by seed75103. Confirm these frozen actors on fresh generated demand.
reporting: Report each seed/case and equal seed/case mean cost/wait/ride/completion; three actual rule runs reused across nine pairs per learned branch; all21 actual evaluations retained
interpretation: Prospective generated-demand confirmation on the same pinned Halifax services, not measured real deployment or source/confidence contribution isolation
code_boundary: CFCMT-owned corrected pool/runtime/source checkpoints/assets only; no mutable Thesis access and no heavy data downloads.
reporting_interpretation: Prospective generated-demand confirmation on the same pinned Halifax services; all21 actual evaluations and all9 pairs per comparison retained, equal case/seed weights, three actual rule runs reused, no old-case pooling or population CI. This does not isolate source or normalized-confidence contribution.
